name: @atusy/tsudoi-language-server
//exports: The published surface is dist/ alone: every conditional export names a compiled file included by `files`, including the CLI subpath used by Deno's npm resolver. There is no package-root export, `main`, or `bin`. The complete map and those refusals are asserted in test/package-shape.test.ts; package.json cannot carry comments, so this field links the declaration to its rationale.
//publishConfig: PUBLIC AND ALPHA ARE DECLARED HERE AS PACKAGE DATA, not remembered as command flags. The access is required for a scoped first publication, and the tag keeps a pre-stable release away from npm's default latest channel. test/release-package-set.test.ts applies the same contract to every public member.
